connector.name: Ausdata MCP
connector.registryDescription: 28 tools over 9 AU gov data sources (ABS, RBA, ATO, APRA, AIHW, ASIC, AEMO, BOM, WGEA) via one key.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package ausdata-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.ausdata, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: AUSDATA_API_KEY
env.description: ausdata.io API key (free tier at https://ausdata.io)
